title: Hong Wang's Fields Medal win reignites debate across China over how its top researchers emerge
subhead: Wang, who chose to study in France and then the United States immediately after earning her undergraduate degree, became a popular figure in China within days of receiving the prestigious medal – illustrating the limitations of a Chinese system built on competition and early selection.

title: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'
